displayName: Trendyol API - Product Prices, Seller Offers, Reviews, Rankings
description: Trendyol API for trendyol.com and 34 international Trendyol storefronts - seller prices for one product (the buy-box seller and every other seller's price, seller score out of 10, the crossed-out price and Trendyol's lowest-price badge with its day count), keyword search, category and brand grids (36 per page, up to 138 pages, sorted by price, newest, best seller, most favourited or most rated, filtered by price, brand, seller, rating, free shipping, rush delivery, discount, lowest-price badge, official seller, flash sale, coupon or any facet) with sponsored items flagged; reviews with the star histogram, topics and Trendyol's own summary; answered seller questions; seller store profiles and catalogs; flash deals and Super Firsatlar; collectable coupons per seller listing; category top-100 rankings; search suggestions; delivery estimates per seller listing. 35 markets in local language and currency (TRY, EUR, CZK, HUF, PLN, RON, RSD, UAH, MDL, AED, SAR, QAR, KWD, OMR, BHD, AZN). 12 endpoints, 1 credit each. No price history and no numeric 30-day lowest price.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
